import type {
  ApiFromModules,
  FilterApi,
  FunctionReference,
} from "convex/server";

type ModuleApi<M extends object, V extends "public" | "internal"> = FilterApi<ApiFromModules<{ "_": M }>, FunctionReference<any, V>> extends { _: infer References } ? References : {};
